resources.string: "Survive Breakout! A reverse breakout survival game."
"Starting in three seconds. Tap empty blocks with one finger."
"No cheating! Regeneration is locked for three seconds."
"The CPU breaks them. You bring them back."
"One finger. Keep rebuilding. Defend the very last block."
"Tap an empty ＋ block to rebuild it"
"One finger only. The balls keep moving!"
"Fate spins every 7 seconds. Survive longer. Score higher."
"Lose all 40 blocks and the game ends"
"No records yet.\nSet your first survival record!"

"You are the god who rebuilds blocks. Keep the CPU from destroying all 40 for as long as you can!

1. Tap an empty, dashed block with one finger. It rebuilds when you lift your finger. Dragging or holding does not rebuild blocks continuously.

2. Touch with two or more fingers at once and you get a NO CHEATING! alert. Regeneration is locked for 3 seconds while the balls keep moving.

3. The single-column slot at the bottom right stops every 7 seconds, automatically giving the CPU a random effect.

+3 balls / double speed / triple speed / pierce for 5 seconds / split for 5 seconds / reset to one ball / reset speed

Combo outcomes: +5 balls & pierce for 5 seconds / triple speed & split for 5 seconds. Both effects activate together. All 9 outcomes have equal odds.

Speed multipliers stack. Winning pierce or split again adds 5 seconds to its remaining time. While split is active, each ball becomes two whenever it hits a block.

4. When the last block breaks, the game ends. Score = survival time in seconds squared. Your best 100 scores are saved on this phone.

The CPU paddle moves quickly from side to side. Balls it cannot reach fall out. If all balls fall out, one new ball launches.

Time and effects freeze while paused or in the background. A 3-second countdown starts when you resume."

"Privacy Policy
Survive Breakout! / ブロック崩しに耐えろ！
Developer: hatake716
Updated: September 13, 2026

This is an offline game. Gameplay is processed on your device. There are no accounts, advertisements, in-app purchases, analytics services, or developer-operated crash reporting. The app does not send gameplay data or personal information to the developer or third parties.

Information stored on your device
The app stores survival time, scores, play dates, rebuild counts, slot counts, your best 100 results, the board, balls and effects of a saved game, and audio, vibration and visual settings in its private storage. Random game identifiers are also used only on your device. This information supports saved games, rankings and preferences.

Permissions and device settings
Vibration is used for touch feedback. Your device language determines whether the interface is Japanese or English. The app does not access contacts, location, the camera, microphone, photos or advertising identifiers. It has no Internet permission.

Retention and deletion
Local information remains while you use the app. Clear the app storage in Android settings or uninstall the app to delete it. Rankings and saved games cannot be recovered after deletion. Android automatic backup is disabled. Any operating-system or device migration features follow the respective provider's specifications.

Contacting support
If you email acesmash@gmail.com, the developer uses your email address and message to respond to your request or investigate a problem, and retains them for as long as needed for that purpose. You can contact the same address about retention or deletion. Email is also subject to your email provider's terms and privacy policy. The app does not send email automatically.

Third-party services
Google Play, Android and email services process information under their own policies. The provider hosting a public support page may process access logs.

Changes
If the app's data practices change, this policy and its revision date will be updated.

Contact: hatake716 / acesmash@gmail.com"
